$comment: Prose overrides for the GENERATED sections of reference.json (design §9.2). Item names must exactly cover the published schema artefacts; desc/tags/order are editorial. Edit THIS file (not reference.json) and run scripts/generate_reference.py.

items.name: schema
items.desc: Manifest schema version. Integer in [1, 2]. Defaults to 1.

items.name: required_executas
items.desc: Executas the App needs. Each entry: `{ tool_id, version?, min_version? }`. `version="latest"` auto-freezes at publish time.

items.name: optional_executas
items.desc: Executas the App can use if installed but does not require. Same shape as `required_executas`.

items.name: host_capabilities
items.desc: Strict allow-list of host-mediated capability strings (validated against `_ALLOWED_HOST_CAPABILITIES`): `aps.kv`, `aps.files`, `aps.scope.*`, `llm.sample`, `llm.complete`, `llm.embed`, `llm.agent.*`, `llm.image`, `web.*`, `host.upload`. Each bundled Executa must also declare its own `host_capabilities`; per-invoke tokens are gated on the Executa declaration + the user's grant.

items.name: permissions
items.desc: Coarse permission tokens shown to the user at install time and enforced at the dispatcher.

items.name: tags
items.desc: Discovery hints; surfaced in App Store search & filters.

items.name: system_prompt_addendum
items.desc: Text injected into the system prompt when the App is active in a turn. Max 4000 chars.

items.name: user_message_prefix_template
items.desc: Optional template prepended to the user message when the App is #mentioned. Max 500 chars.

items.name: ui
items.desc: UI bundle section: declares bundle entry, views, host_api grants, CSP overrides. See "UI manifest".

items.name: dev
items.desc: Local-harness-only config (fixtures, mocks, seed_storage, user_id). Stripped by `anna-app publish`; ignored by production dispatcher.

items.name: agent.session.create
items.desc: Mint a server-side `AnnaAppSession` (kind=`agent`). Validates `submode` against the manifest grant and `fixed_client_id` against the allow-list; optional `systemPrompt` overrides the agent's system prompt. Returns `{app_session_uuid, expires_in, submode, fixed_client_id, system_prompt, granted_tools, inherit_host_tools}` (`granted_tools` is runtime-resolved via `effective_granted_tool_names`, NOT a raw manifest echo).

items.name: agent.session.catalog
items.desc: Pre-create discovery of the platform-tool universe: which names are legal in create-time `quotaCaps.allowed_tools` / per-run `allowed_tools`, and whether they would resolve for THIS app. Returns `{platform_tools: [{name, description, dev_safe, declared_in_manifest, user_granted, eligible, blocked_by?}], inherit_host_tools_granted, manifest_declared, user_granted}`. `blocked_by` pinpoints WHY a tool is unavailable (`manifest` = not declared in `ui.host_api.agent.tools`; `user_grant` = not authorized in the Permissions modal). Read-only — mints no session, consumes no quota. Previously the resolved surface was only visible after-the-fact via the create response's `granted_tools` echo.

items.name: agent.session.run
items.desc: Submit a user turn; returns SYNCHRONOUSLY with `{stream_id, run_id}`. LangGraph response frames arrive via `rpc.stream` events; the SDK's `AgentRunStream` reassembles by `seq` into an `AsyncIterable`. Terminal frame is always `{event:'end', run_id}` + `done:true`. Optional per-run fields: `attachments` (native multimodal image inputs — the session's vision model sees them directly, image/* only, ≤6, SSRF-guarded URLs or base64 `data`; non-vision model fails fast with `APP_MODEL_NOT_VISION_CAPABLE`), `allowed_tools` (narrow this run's tool surface — sandbox sessions only), `modelPreferences`, `systemPrompt`.

items.name: agent.session.cancel
items.desc: Best-effort cancellation. Records a cancel signal keyed by `(app_session_uuid, run_id)` and maps it onto the underlying worker task: a still-queued run is dropped before start; a running run stops at the next poll checkpoint (every ~30 stream events) — an in-flight provider call still completes. Returns `{cancelled: bool}` — NOT a confirmation the run actually stopped (watch for the `task_cancelled` delta and terminal `end` frame).

items.name: agent.session.history
items.desc: Read the tail of the LangGraph `channel_values.messages` checkpoint. **Best-effort:** returns `{messages: []}` (NOT an error) when the checkpoint store is unavailable or the thread has no writes yet. `limit` clamped to `[1, 200]`, default 50.

items.name: agent.session.delete
items.desc: Soft-revoke the session, cancel all of its active runs (best-effort fan-out, forum #191), and pop its cached capability token. Idempotent.

items.name: agent.session.list
items.desc: Enumerate the caller's own agent sessions, scoped to this app (`window.app_id`). Returns `{sessions: [{app_session_uuid, kind, submode, fixed_client_id, label, created_at, last_active_at, expires_at, max_lifetime_at}]}` — metadata only, no token. `include_expired?` (default false); `limit` clamped `[1, 100]`, default 50. Use it to re-attach after an iframe reload instead of minting a duplicate.

items.name: agent.session.refresh
items.desc: Re-mint a fresh capability token for an existing `app_session_uuid` and slide its idle window forward — WITHOUT re-creating the session (which would orphan the LangGraph `thread_id`). Can never push past `max_lifetime_at`. Returns `{app_session_uuid, expires_in, submode, fixed_client_id, expires_at, max_lifetime_at, idle_ttl_seconds, session_expires_in}`.

items.name: chat.append_artifact
items.desc: Attach a generated artifact to the current turn. Reads `args.artifact` (object); fields `kind` (≤40 chars, default `app_event`), `app_slug`, `summary` (≤1000 chars), `payload_ref`, `data`. Emits an `artifact_appended` event and returns `{artifact_id}` (`app-<window_uuid[:8]>-<unix_ts>`). Fully implemented.

items.name: chat.write_message
items.desc: Append a message authored by the App. `role` (default `assistant`), `content` (string, truncated to ≤4000 chars). Emits a `chat_message_from_app` event and returns `{message_id}` (`msg-<unix_ms>`). **Phase-3 functional stub — does NOT persist.**

items.name: chat.read_history
items.desc: Read prior turns of the chat thread. **Phase-3 stub — raises `not_implemented`.**

items.name: llm.complete
items.desc: MCP-shaped single-shot completion. `messages` required (array, non-empty). `maxTokens` silently clamped to `session.quota_caps.max_tokens_per_call` (default 4096). Provider + model resolved server-side from `modelPreferences ∩ user-grant`. Returns `{role, content:{type:'text', text}, model, stopReason:'endTurn', usage:{inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens}, _meta:{provider, latencyMs, quotaConsumed, appSessionUuid}}`. Errors: `APP_NOT_GRANTED`, `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`, `APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`.

items.name: llm.stream
items.desc: Streaming L1 completion (SDK ≥ 0.10.0 / dispatcher ≥ 0.12.0). Same request shape as `llm.complete` but returns an async-iterable stream: `{event:'model_token', text}` frames followed by a terminal `{event:'complete', role, content, model, stopReason, usage, _meta}` over the shared `rpc.stream` topic. Grant via `manifest.ui.host_api.llm` containing `stream` (or `*`); same quota model as `complete`. Old hosts return `-32601` — feature-detect and fall back to `llm.complete`.

items.name: image.generate
items.desc: Generate `n` images (default 1) from a text `prompt`, optional `size` (default `1024x1024`) and `reference_image_urls`. Returns `{images:[{url}], model, quota_used, latency_ms, …}` with ~30-min-TTL presigned R2 URLs.

items.name: image.edit
items.desc: Restyle / mask-edit an existing `image_url` per a text `prompt`. Optional `mask_url` for inpainting where the provider supports it. Source is not modified; results land in fresh R2 objects.

items.name: upload.inline
items.desc: ≤ 20 MiB inline base64 upload. One round-trip; SDK should pre-check `file.size` to fall back to `negotiate` rather than re-encoding on `TOO_LARGE`.

items.name: upload.negotiate
items.desc: Mint a presigned R2 PUT URL (~5 min TTL) + the durable `r2_key`. Does NOT charge the file counter — `confirm` does. Caller MUST copy the returned `headers` (especially `Content-Type`) onto the PUT verbatim or R2 rejects with SignatureDoesNotMatch.

items.name: upload.confirm
items.desc: HEAD R2 to verify the PUT, charge the file counter, return a fresh `download_url`. Idempotent on success (same `r2_key` re-confirm just re-mints the URL — useful for refreshing expired downloads).

items.name: storage.get
items.desc: Read a value by key. Returns `{value, etag, generation, exists: true}` on hit, `{value: null, exists: false}` on miss / expired / soft-deleted. `etag` feeds back into `set` / `delete` as `if_match` for optimistic concurrency.

items.name: storage.set
items.desc: Upsert a JSON value. Supports `if_match` (optimistic concurrency), `metadata` / `tags` (round-trip on `list`), `ttl_seconds` (auto-expire 1 s..365 d). Returns `{etag, generation, size_bytes}`. Charges per-user byte / entry quota; legacy backend caps the whole bucket at 256 KiB and broadcasts `runtime_state_synced`.

items.name: storage.list
items.desc: Page through keys under `prefix`. Returns metadata-only rows (`{key, etag, size_bytes, metadata, tags, updated_at}`) — no `value`. `limit` 1..1000 (default 100); `cursor` is opaque, not persistable across deploys.

items.name: storage.delete
items.desc: Soft-delete a key; quota bytes are reclaimed immediately. Accepts `if_match` (APS only). APS raises `not_found` on a missing key; the legacy backend silently no-ops.

items.name: llm.embed
items.desc: Compute dense embeddings for one string or a batch. Returns OpenAI-shaped `{object:'list', model, data:[{index,embedding}], usage, _meta}`. `model` is the stable alias (persist this), `_meta.dimensions` is immutable per alias, `_meta.backendModel` is audit-only. Independent billing surface from `llm.complete`.

items.name: files.upload_init
items.desc: Phase 1 of upload — reserve a `pending` row, count `size` against quota, return a single-use R2 presigned PUT URL the browser uses directly. Pair with `upload_finalize`.

items.name: files.upload_finalize
items.desc: Phase 2 of upload — verify the PUT with R2 `HEAD`, flip the row to `active`, commit quota, return the canonical `etag` / `generation`.

items.name: files.download_url
items.desc: Mint a short-lived R2 presigned GET URL. Embed in `` / `

items.name: files.download
items.desc: Host-mediated save (forum #175) — presigns a GET with forced `Content-Disposition: attachment`; the host page (not the sandboxed iframe) clicks a top-level anchor so the browser download dialog opens and the presigned URL never enters app DOM. Args: `path`, optional `filename` / `ttl_seconds` / `scope` / `owner`.

items.name: files.list
items.desc: Page metadata-only rows under an optional `prefix`. Returns `path`, `etag`, `size_bytes`, `content_type`, `metadata`, `tags`, `updated_at`. Cursor-based. Optional `scope`/`owner` args (default: own app scope): with manifest `host_capabilities: ["aps.scope.app.read"]`, `owner` may reference ANOTHER app by its public ref (`@handle/slug` or numeric id — bare slugs rejected, slugs are only unique per developer namespace) to browse the objects it stores under the calling user (e.g. `anna.web.image_fetch` artifacts). Rows are always filtered by the calling user's id.

items.name: files.delete
items.desc: Soft-delete; quota reclaimed immediately, R2 object reaped async. Accepts `if_match`.

items.name: tools.list
items.desc: Project the manifest's tool grants. Returns `{tools: [{tool_id, status?}]}` filtered through the `host_api.tools` whitelist; the optional `status` (`available` / `deploying` / `unavailable`, dispatcher ≥ 0.14.0) reflects live deploy-reconciliation facts — disable buttons before a click fails, and pair with `anna.tools.onChanged(cb)` (SDK ≥ 0.12.0) to re-list when `tools.changed` fires after a deploy lands. Pure ACL — no Agent / NATS round-trip; safe to call at bundle boot to decide which buttons to render.

items.name: tools.invoke
items.desc: Call one tool by id with structured `args` and an optional clamped `timeoutMs` (**max 90 s** — the public edge's held-request ceiling). Routes through the user's online Executa Agent over NATS, strips two envelope layers, and returns the plugin payload — or a stable error code (`tool_timeout`, `tool_failed`, `executa_unavailable`, `agent_unavailable`, `permission_denied`, `invalid_arg`). Calls that may outlive 90 s belong on `tools.invokeAsync`.

items.name: tools.invokeAsync
items.desc: Start a long tool call as a host-owned **job** and return `{jobId, state: "queued", deadlineMs}` immediately — no long-held HTTP request. `timeoutMs` is the job deadline (default 30 min, clamp 60 s–24 h); `clientTag` (≤120 chars) is your reload-recovery key. Progress/terminal updates are pushed as `tool_job` window events and read authoritatively via `tools.getJob`. SDK sugar: `anna.tools.invokeAsyncAwait(args, {onProgress, signal})`.

items.name: tools.getJob
items.desc: Authoritative job snapshot + incremental progress: `{jobId, sinceSeq?, limit?}` → `JobSnapshot` with `state`, `result` (succeeded), structured `error` (failed/cancelled/expired), and the progress slice with `seq > sinceSeq` (per-job ring of the latest 500). Also the polling fallback and the reload-recovery read — events are an optimisation, this is the truth.

items.name: tools.cancelJob
items.desc: Cooperative, **idempotent** cancel: active job → agent-side graceful task cancel (same plugin's other invokes are untouched; process-group kill only as 500 ms fallback) and `state: "cancelled"`; terminal job → `{cancelled: false}` no-op. Optional `reason` (≤200 chars) lands in the job's error message.

items.name: tools.listJobs
items.desc: Recent jobs for the current user — the reload-recovery entry point. Filter by `tool_id`, `state` (single or array), `clientTag`, `since` (RFC3339, ≤7 d lookback); `limit` 1–100 (default 20). Returns `{jobs, truncated}` sorted newest-first. Cross-user rows never appear (ownership is enforced row-level).

items.name: credentials.list_accounts
items.desc: `{provider}` → `{accounts: [{account_id, email, label, is_default, status, scopes}]}`. Metadata only — never tokens. Render an account picker or feed `account_id` into `get_token`.

items.name: credentials.get_token
items.desc: `{provider, account_id?}` → `{access_token, account_id, expires_at}`. Omit `account_id` for the user's default account. Dead credentials (revoked / needs re-auth) fail with `APP_NOT_GRANTED` carrying the reconnect hint.

items.name: web.search
items.desc: `{query, max_results?, search_depth?, topic?, time_range?, region?, include_domains?, exclude_domains?}` → `{results: [{title, url, snippet, site, published_at?, score?}], provider_tier, quota_consumed}`. `score`/`published_at` are optional — never assume they exist. Out-of-cap params are REJECTED (`APP_INVALID_REQUEST`), never silently truncated. `search_depth: "advanced"` needs `web_grant.allowAdvanced`; usage is metered by the CU pool only (no per-minute/daily caps).

items.name: web.fetch
items.desc: `{urls (1-10), format?, max_chars?, timeout_ms?}` → `{pages: [{url, final_url?, ok, title?, content?, truncated?, error?}], quota_consumed}` — same length & order as input, **per-item failure isolation** (check `pages[i].ok`; errors: `SSRF_BLOCKED`, `TIMEOUT`, `HTTP_<status>`, `PARSE_FAILED`, `TOO_LARGE`, `RESPONSE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`, …). Hard SSRF policy: private/metadata IPs blocked after DNS resolution, re-validated per redirect hop. 512 KB response budget. `web_grant` shape: `{enabled, allowSearch, allowFetch, allowAdvanced, allowImageSearch, allowImageFetch, maxResultsPerCall (10)}` — default disabled; edited in the Installed-Apps permission modal; `anna-app dev` installs seed a fully-enabled dev grant (dev calls never billed). Pass `{timeoutMs: 90000}` for large batches (SDK web-namespace default is 60s).

items.name: web.image_search
items.desc: `{query, max_results? (8, cap 50), min_width?, min_height?, aspect? (any|wide|tall|square)}` → `{results: [{image_url, thumbnail_url?, source_url, title?, width?, height?, mime_type?, license_hint?}], quota_consumed, cached?}`. **Safe-search is force-enabled platform-side** (`safe_search: false` is rejected). `license_hint` is best-effort — no copyright warranty. Needs `web_grant.allowImageSearch` (defaults OFF even when web is enabled). Results cached 10 min; cache hits bill the floor CU and set `cached: true`. Provider chain: serper (Google Images, when key configured) → ddgs.images → tavily include_images. SDK alias `anna.web.imageSearch`.

items.name: web.image_fetch
items.desc: `{url, max_bytes? (5 MiB, cap 20 MiB), purpose?}` → `{path, get_url, mime_type, bytes_size, sha256, source_url, final_url, quota_consumed}` — an artifact REFERENCE (`get_url` is a 30-min presigned URL; field is `get_url`, not `url`), never bytes. Host downloads with the full SSRF policy + image MIME whitelist (jpeg/png/webp/gif) verified by **magic bytes**, then stores into the app's APS files self-scope (counts against storage quota; manage via `anna.files.*`). Needs `web_grant.allowImageFetch` (defaults OFF). 1.0 CU floor per image; failed downloads never billed. SDK alias `anna.web.imageFetch`.

items.name: apps.list
items.desc: List the user's installed (enabled) apps with basic metadata for a launcher grid.

items.name: apps.search
items.desc: Filter installed apps by name/slug substring.

items.name: apps.get
items.desc: Fetch one installed app by `app_ref` (id or `@handle/slug`).

items.name: apps.launch
items.desc: Open an installed app's window (optionally a named `view` with a `payload`). Emits `open_view`.

items.name: apps.deck.list
items.desc: Read the pinned deck, in order.

items.name: apps.deck.add
items.desc: Pin an installed app to the deck.

items.name: apps.deck.remove
items.desc: Unpin an app from the deck.

items.name: apps.deck.reorder
items.desc: Persist a new deck order (full list of app ids).

items.name: window.hello
items.desc: Initial handshake from the bundle to the runtime.

items.name: window.ready
items.desc: Bundle signals it is ready to receive `runtime_state` and events.

items.name: window.report_error
items.desc: Forward a bundle-side exception to the host error log.

items.name: window.open_view
items.desc: Open one of the views declared in `ui.views`.

items.name: window.close
items.desc: Close the current (or named) view.

items.name: window.focus
items.desc: Pull a view to the foreground.

items.name: window.set_title
items.desc: Update the window chrome title at runtime.

items.name: window.resize
items.desc: Programmatically resize the current view (subject to min/max in the view spec).

items.name: artifact.create
items.desc: Artifact create — reserved.

items.name: artifact.update
items.desc: Artifact update — reserved.

items.name: artifact.delete
items.desc: Artifact delete — reserved.

items.name: fs.read
items.desc: Sandboxed filesystem read — reserved.

items.name: fs.write
items.desc: Sandboxed filesystem write — reserved.

items.name: prefs.get
items.desc: User preference reads — reserved.

items.name: ping
items.desc: Keep-alive heartbeat. Ignore unless you care about connection liveness.

items.name: open_view
items.desc: A new view instance was opened (typically by `window.open_view` or `default=true`).

items.name: close_view
items.desc: A view instance was closed by the user or the bundle.

items.name: window_focus_changed
items.desc: Focus moved between views.

items.name: geometry_changed
items.desc: The user resized or moved a window.

items.name: title_changed
items.desc: The window title was updated (via `window.set_title`).

items.name: status_changed
items.desc: High-level App status transition surfaced by the runtime.

items.name: runtime_state_synced
items.desc: Hydrated state delivered after `window.ready`, or after a remote storage write.

items.name: artifact_appended
items.desc: A `chat.append_artifact` call landed in the conversation.

items.name: chat_message_from_app
items.desc: A `chat.write_message` call from this App was committed to the thread.

items.name: rpc.stream
items.desc: Progressive frame from a streaming RPC (tool or LLM call).

items.name: anna_app_tools_changed
items.desc: Deploy reconciliation landed this app's tools on the agent (MCP list-changed analogue). Re-run `anna.tools.list()` and re-enable buttons; or subscribe via `anna.tools.onChanged(cb)`.

items.name: executa_reconcile_result
items.desc: Outcome of a one-click executa repair / reconcile run (成功/失败 + per-executa detail). Surfaced to the initiating window.

items.name: executa_readiness
items.desc: Window-open probe found required executas not yet ready on the agent — render a preparing/degraded mask until `anna_app_tools_changed` arrives.
